text: Beam strikes the glass surface; most light transmits, a fraction reflects.
The beam bends on entering the denser medium, per Snell's law.
The prism separates the beam by wavelength; violet bends more than red.
A narrow slit spreads the beam into a fringe pattern.
A polarizing filter attenuates the beam by Malus's law.
Off-axis rays miss the ideal focus; the spot grows with aperture and field angle.
